candidates.title: Old Republic SITH LORDS vs Movie SITH LORDS
candidates.publisher_synopsis: The power comparison between the Old Republic Sith Lords and more recent Sith Lords is a topic of debate among Star Wars fans. The Old Republic era featured legendary Sith Lords like Darth Revan and Darth Vitiate, known for their mastery of the dark side and strategic brilliance. These Sith Lords often displayed incredible Force abilities and considerable influence over the galaxy. However, the more recent Sith Lords, like Darth Sidious (Emperor Palpatine) and Darth Vader, demonstrated immense power as well. Darth Sidious was a master manipulator who orchestrated the rise of the Galactic Empire and possessed unparalleled mastery of dark side techniques. Darth Vader, while physically limited due to his injuries, was still a formidable Force user and skilled lightsaber duelist. candidates.publisher_synopsis: Elysia wanders off the Canon path, this time with the help of Marcin, to talk about one of the most important and beloved series in the history of Star Wars games: The Knights of the Old Republic, The Knights of Old Republic II: The Sith Lords, and The Old Republic MMO. candidates.title: Sanxingdui and the Shu State
candidates.publisher_synopsis: This week, we explore yet another place that’s not a backwater or influenced by aliens! In 1986, two pits were excavated at the site of Sanxingdui (Three Stars Mound) in what is today China’s Sichuan province. These two pits, and six more uncovered in 2021, were full of bronze, jade, gold, and ivory objects that appear to have been “sacrificed” (burned or broken) before burial. The artifacts were made in a style never before seen in Chinese material culture. What was going on at Sanxingdui, and why was the site abruptly abandoned thousands of years ago? We can tell you right off the bat that it wasn’t aliens, but you’ll have to listen to the episode to find out more! Interested in learning about how to use X-Rays and similar technology in archaeology? Check out the linked PaleoImaging course from James Elliot!
